resources.string: BioManager on your phone opens your lab\'s BioManager server. Ask your lab\'s BioManager admin for its address.
Using the BioManager desktop app on your own computer? That copy only works on that computer. To use your phone too, your lab needs a BioManager server.
That address answered, but it isn\'t a BioManager server.
Couldn\'t reach %1$s. Check the address, and that your phone is on the lab\'s network or VPN.
The server\'s certificate isn\'t trusted by this phone. If your lab uses its own certificate, install it in Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials, then try again.
This address isn\'t https, so passwords are sent unencrypted. Use it only on a network you trust.
The QR scanner needs Google Play services, which this phone doesn\'t have. Your camera app can scan cage cards instead.
That code is for a different server: %1$s
That code isn\'t a BioManager link.
Ready: this phone has a fresh copy of the lab to work on without a signal.
This phone has no copy of the lab yet. Open BioManager once with a signal, signed in, and it keeps one.
